logoPrompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create ONE exceptionally clean professional original space mission emblem for the educational spaceflight game named exactly "KINETIC CORE". This should look like the master identity art that could be embroidered as a patch or printed on a lunar flag, not a photograph/mockup.
A classic CIRCULAR mission badge: a black disc, restrained thin white outer/inner border, very strong simple white custom geometric "KC" monogram at center, an elegant single orbital path surrounding the monogram with a small four-point navigation star. Small simple lunar horizon arc in the lower quarter. Incorporate a small tasteful two-band Ukrainian BLUE over YELLOW motif in the lower part of the emblem (#0057b7 blue, #ffd700 yellow), as a band or horizon detail. White is dominant, blue and yellow are supporting accents. Arc the readable words "KINETIC CORE" across the upper inner rim using precise bold aerospace sans lettering, with no other text, no year, no invented slogan or extra proper names. The KC is the focal point and remains recognizable at small sizes.
Flat vector-style master art: simple strong silhouettes, minimal geometric paths, consistent stroke logic, 4 flat colors only (black, white, Ukrainian blue, Ukrainian yellow), no gradients, no photographic texture, no embroidery texture, no bevel, no 3D, no shadows, no glow, no tiny fussy stars, no complex earth photo or nebula. The emblem should be balanced and timeless, high contrast, genuinely suitable for an embroidered patch. Original mark with no NASA insignia, no copied agency patch, no red NASA swoosh, no official seal, no coat of arms. Avoid making the C look like G. Text must read exactly KINETIC CORE, K-I-N-E-T-I-C space C-O-R-E, and center KC with Latin K and C.
Output a high resolution square image with a truly TRANSPARENT background outside the black circular badge, centered with 7% clear padding. One logo only, no variations sheet or mockup.

heroPrompts.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural, fresh generation with identity reference.
Generate a COMPLETELY NEW lunar portrait from scratch. Input1 is the ORIGINAL user portrait of Mykyta Borisov: use only to preserve the recognizable facial identity and apparent young age. Do not inherit its flat studio lighting, exact head pose or warm skin color. Input2 is only the Kinetic Core logo artwork for a SMALL physical suit patch. There is NO previous scene image to edit. Rebuild the entire scene, person, helmet and suit with fresh coherent anatomy, clean geometry and photographic texture, avoiding cumulative image-edit artifacts.
Subject: same boy, short brown hair, natural youthful features and expression. Anatomically believable head/neck/shoulder relationship inside a modern white technical-textile lunar EVA suit. Dark charcoal flexible joints, restrained burgundy bands, compact low-profile chest hardware, integrated life-support pack, carefully routed protected cable, small tether clip. Broad clear sealed visor, his face unobscured, no melted edges, no doubled features or hardware. Two small practical neutral-white LED task lights in the outer temple housings, visibly on at restrained intensity.
A small circular embroidered Kinetic Core mission emblem on the upper chest reproduces Input2: KC, thin orbital path/star, black/white and a small Ukrainian blue-over-yellow horizon detail. One small handmade cloth note says 'Space Apps' then '2026'. No other badges, logos or text. No large title, no author overlay, no watermark or AI caption.
Cinematography: a real large-format cinema camera with a 2x ANAMORPHIC portrait lens, carefully de-squeezed into the requested final aspect ratio. Subtle narrow HORIZONTAL optical light streaks caused ONLY by the actual helmet LED emitters, restrained blue-cyan coating signature, small oval out-of-focus background light highlights where physically plausible. No giant flare washing the face, no floating light bars. Shallow but believable depth of field: face and main helmet/suit plane sharply focused, distant lunar module and terrain softly defocused, small Earth identifiable but slightly out of focus. Fine natural 35mm-style film grain, gently textured shadows, restrained cinematic tonal response and highlight roll-off. Not clean sterile CGI, not plastic/waxy skin, not fake oversharpening, not heavy digital noise.
Scene: gray airless lunar surface, quiet low lunar ridge, black starless sky, small blue-white Earth and one small distant fictional four-legged lunar module. Preserve correct lighting: one low hard sunlight direction, subtle gray lunar bounce, believable cool/neutral shaded skin color, realistic visor reflections and visible natural pores. Genuine tactile fabric, worn stitching, fine scuffs, localized regolith dust, no decorative damage.
Composition: waist-up astronaut on RIGHT, broad genuinely empty black LEFT field and safe edges for later typography/logos. No extra people, flags, clutter or nebula. ONE image.

Helmet top around y12%, face x75% y33%, torso cropped at waist/bottom. Warm-neutral sunlight from upper-left, cooler gray shadow side. Small Earth x47% y24%; softly blurred distant lander x26% y82%; lunar ground bottom22%. LEFT42% upper area nearly pureblack for title. Small anamorphic LED streaks remain localized, elegant natural filmgrain.
